title: Morning check: quick skills from the game's table, aimed skill on the aim button, the pawn downer (no hands, about 3 minutes)
intro: About 3 minutes, nothing to press after End. Open ground, no enemies near, full party (Fighter, Archer, Thief as last night), a controller connected. Hands off until PASS / FAIL shows. One goblin that stands still is spawned as a target; one pawn is put down and brought back.

steps.text: A goblin that stands still, 10 m ahead

expect.label: member 1 slot 1: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 1 slot 2: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 1 slot 3: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 1 slot 4: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 2 slot 1: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 2 slot 2: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 2 slot 3: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 2 slot 4: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 3 slot 1: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 3 slot 2: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 3 slot 3: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)
member 3 slot 4: order accepted (or the slot is empty / the target is gone)

steps.text: The game's skill table was read

expect.label: skill table read from the game (more than 100 action packs)
DirectPawnControl: no errors
CameraDistance: no errors

steps.text: Take control of party member 2 (the Archer)

expect.label: possession started

steps.text: Robot: aim button held, then skill 1's button (no skill shift)

expect.label: aimed skill fired on the game's aim button (Archer pawn only; fails if member 2 is not a bow pawn)
possession started

steps.text: Party member 3 is put down (developer tool)

expect.label: the downer puts a pawn down

steps.text: The Arisen (Magick Archer) should fire a Remedy Arrow at her, or a pawn picks her up

expect.label: the downed pawn is back up within 25 s (information: fails if nobody helped)

steps.text: Clean up: everyone healed, enemies removed

expect.label: nobody is left down
DirectPawnControl: no errors
CameraDistance: no errors

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.dpc: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.info
probes.sel: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.sel_label
probes.holds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.holds or 0) or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.lock_ok:
local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not (D and D.state.active and D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl and D.state.pawn_chara) then return nil end
local c = D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl:get_field('Chara'); return c ~= nil and c:get_address() == D.state.pawn_chara:get_address()
probes.lockfix: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.lock_fixes or 0) or 0
probes.ring:
local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.GuiManager'); local u = gm and gm:get_field('MagicBowReticle'); if not u then return false end
return u:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_DrawSelf') == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0
probes.skills: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.skill_uses or 0
probes.bmode: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.mode
probes.world: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.world
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.binds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.bind and D.R.bind.sig
probes.kb: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.kbind ~= nil
probes.map: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_arisen_brain.json'); return ok and d and d.coop and d.coop.map
probes.p2f: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_arisen_brain.json'); return ok and d and d.coop and d.coop.p2_flags
probes.qres: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_quick.json'); return ok and d and (tostring(d.pawn) .. ' slot ' .. tostring(d.slot) .. ' ' .. tostring(d.name) .. ': ' .. tostring(d.result) .. ' [' .. tostring(d.source) .. ']')
probes.qn: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_quick.json'); return ok and d and d.n or 0
probes.qok: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_quick.json'); return ok and d and (d.result == 'ordered' or d.result == 'slot empty' or d.result == 'no enemy')
probes.qtbl: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_skill_table.json'); return ok and d and d.rows or 0
probes.aimsk: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.aim and d.aim.aim_skills or 0
probes.dead2: local p = H.pawn(2); return p ~= nil and p:call('get_IsDead') == true
probes.job1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.pawn_job
